}}'''Tialin''' is an [[Aiel]] [[Wise One]].

== Appearance ==
She is lanky and red-haired.

== Strength and Abilities ==
She can [[channel]] the [[One Power]]. She is of no more than middling strength with ''[[saidar]]''.

This is not confirmed by TWoTC because her level is described there as {{opsl|24}}, which is a high level by Aes Sedai standard (a middling level is around {{opsl|40}} and it is more than enough to open suitable gateway to [[Travel]].

== Activities ==
She is one of the [[Wise Ones]] who are supervising the [[Aes Sedai]] held prisoner by the [[Aiel]] in [[Cairhien]].

It can be assumed that during the Last Battle she fights in [[Thakan'dar]] Valley along the other Wise Ones.
